summary: get_budget_snapshot projects would_pause/would_throttle (and next-cycle aliases) when remaining is below per_cycle even without an estimate, matching cost dashboard next-cycle breach semantics for feed/PM/ops status.
migration_impact: Snapshots with low remaining now set would_pause_next_cycle=true without requiring estimated_tokens. Consumers that only checked would_pause after an estimate now see the gate earlier.
agent_notes: Treat would_pause_next_cycle as true when remaining < per_cycle (or remaining=0). Pressure remains critical/exhausted independently.
